events.description: Ross Geller says Ben Geller is currently nodding off.
Monica Geller tells everyone to look at Ben Geller.
Phoebe Buffay says Ben Geller has Ross Geller's haircut.
Rachel Green asks Ross Geller to let Rachel Green see Ben Geller.
Rachel Green says Ben Geller is the sweetest thing.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller wants to kiss Ben Geller all over.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller kissing Ben Geller all over would be nice.
Rachel Green asks Chandler Bing to repeat what Chandler Bing just said.
Joey Tribbiani asks Chandler Bing to help Joey Tribbiani out.
Joey Tribbiani promises that Joey Tribbiani will pay Chandler Bing back.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani owes Chandler Bing 17 jillion dollars, including for the waffles from last week.
Chandler Bing asks where the money Joey Tribbiani will use to repay Chandler Bing is coming from.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is helping out at the N.Y.U. Medical School with some research.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller has heard of science.
Joey Tribbiani says the research at the N.Y.U. Medical School is a fertility study.
Monica Geller asks Joey Tribbiani to tell Monica Geller that Joey Tribbiani is only donating his time to the fertility study.
Joey Tribbiani urges Ross Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing to come on.
Joey Tribbiani says the fertility study situation is not that big a deal.
Joey Tribbiani says every other day Joey Tribbiani goes to the N.Y.U. Medical School and makes his contribution to the fertility study project.
Joey Tribbiani says that at the end of two weeks Joey Tribbiani will get seven hundred dollars.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani is going to be making money hand over fist.
